Join Coach Kozak and Claudia through over 1,000 on-demand home workout routines and exercise plans for all goals.

• Named “Top Fitness App” for 10 years straight
• 99% approval rating on over 1 Billion completed workouts

Become the best version of you with the free HASfit app:

• Home workout routines for all fitness levels (limited mobility, senior, beginner, intermediate, advanced)
• Get up to 2x faster results by following a complete fitness plan
• Stream your workouts to your TV using your Chromecast, Roku, Amazon Fire, or AppleTV
• Search to find your perfect workout from 3 – 60 minutes
• Modifications to help you customize the workout for your specific needs
• Save your favorite routines for easy access later
• Exercise with dumbbells or no equipment

Discover new workouts added each week:
• Fat Burning
• HIIT & Tabata
• Muscle Building
• Cardio
• Strength Training
• Low Impact
• Kickboxing and MMA
• Kettlebell
• Flexibility and Yoga

Find Complete Workout Plans and Programs!
